title: Making MLLM Latents Matter: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning for Cinematic Video Generation
title_zh: 让 MLLM 潜变量真正发挥作用：面向电影级视频生成的因子感知预测学习

paragraphs.en: Cinematic video generation requires both temporal inference from limited inputs ( i.e. , sparse rather than frame-by-frame guidance) and factor-aware control of character, scene, action, and camera. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer useful priors for both capabilities, but their representations are not automatically actionable for video generation: a Video Diffusion Transformer (DiT) may bypass them through native conditioning pathways, and using them does not ensure either factor-aware control or generation-compatible temporal prediction. We propose Factor-Aware Predictive Learning (FAPL) , which establishes effective MLLM latent use as a shared prerequisite and then targets the two capabilities with complementary learning signals. First, latent-only generator grounding trains the DiT with a frozen MLLM and connector, strengthening the DiT’s use of MLLM latents for generation. Second, for factor-aware control , paired videos specify a target-factor change and non-target preservation, and factor-span replacement trains the DiT to realize this relationship in its output. Third, for temporal inference , text-only and text-plus-complete-video observations share a video target, and the trained DiT is then frozen while the MLLM and connector are optimized through it. This final stage trains limited-input representations for generation while retaining complete-observation reconstruction as a complementary training mode. Extensive experiments demonstrate our consistently better performance on three cinematic video generation tasks ( i.e. , sparse-to-video, factor-aware editing, and multi-shot generation) over baselines and validate FAPL’s contributions to MLLM feature use, temporal control, and factor coordination. paragraphs.zh: 电影级视频生成既需要从有限输入（即稀疏引导而非逐帧引导）进行时间推断，也需要对角色、场景、动作和摄像机进行因素感知的控制。 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）为这两种能力提供了有用的先验，但其表示并不能自动转化为视频生成可用的形式：视频扩散Transformer（DiT）可能通过原生条件通路绕过它们，而且使用它们既不能保证因素感知的控制，也不能保证与生成兼容的时间预测。 我们提出因素感知预测学习（FAPL），它将有效使用MLLM潜在表示确立为共同前提，然后通过互补的学习信号针对这两种能力进行优化。 首先，仅潜在表示的生成器接地使用冻结的MLLM和连接器来训练DiT，强化DiT在生成中对MLLM潜在表示的使用。 其次，对于因素感知控制，成对视频指定目标因素的变化和非目标因素的保持，并通过因素跨度替换训练DiT在其输出中实现这种关系。 第三，对于时间推断，纯文本观察和文本加完整视频观察共享同一个视频目标，随后冻结训练好的DiT，并通过它优化MLLM和连接器。 这一最后阶段在保留完整观察重建作为补充训练模式的同时，训练用于生成的有限输入表示。 大量实验表明，在三个电影级视频生成任务（即稀疏到视频、因素感知编辑和多镜头生成）上，我们的性能始终优于基线方法，并验证了FAPL对MLLM特征使用、时间控制和因素协调的贡献。 项目主页：https://shotverse.github.io/fapl/

paragraphs.en: Cinematic video generation ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Tang et al., 2026 ) helps creators explore content, performances, and camera choices before physical production. Beyond visual realism, it requires two capabilities (Fig. 1 ). (i) Temporal inference from limited inputs requires the model to construct plausible action sequences and camera motion from a script and a few visual references ( Xiao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , which only sparsely specify how a shot unfolds ( i.e. , they do not provide a dense, frame-by-frame specification of all visual content). (ii) Factor-aware control requires character, scene, action, and camera to follow their respective instructions while remaining compatible: changing a character should preserve the requested action, and changing camera motion should not replace the scene ( Huang et al., 2026b ; Girish et al., 2026 ) . Therefore, the central challenge is not only to infer missing content, but also to make those inferences selectively controllable in the generated video.
paragraphs.zh: 电影级视频生成（Wang et al., 2025a；Wu et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026b；Yang et al., 2026b；Tang et al., 2026）帮助创作者在实体拍摄之前探索内容、表演和镜头选择。 除了视觉真实感之外，它还需要两项能力（图 1）。 (i) 从有限输入进行时间推断，要求模型根据剧本和少量视觉参考（Xiao et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026a）构建合理的动作序列和镜头运动，而这些参考只是稀疏地规定了一个镜头如何展开（即它们并不提供对所有视觉内容的逐帧密集规定）。 (ii) 因子感知的控制，要求角色、场景、动作和镜头各自遵循相应的指令，同时保持相互兼容：更换角色应当保留所要求的动作，而更改镜头运动不应当替换场景（Huang et al., 2026b；Girish et al., 2026）。 因此，核心挑战不仅是推断缺失的内容，还要使这些推断在生成的视频中可被选择性地控制。

paragraphs.en: Standard conditioning provides limited support for these requirements. Text encoders ( Raffel et al., 2020 ; Radford et al., 2021 ) offer limited visual and temporal grounding, while VAE-encoded references ( Kingma and Welling, 2013 ) preserve appearance without explicitly representing action or camera intent. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) provide a promising alternative ( Wang et al., 2026 ) : their visual priors and semantic reasoning can help interpret scripts and references, infer plausible temporal details, and coordinate cinematic factors. Recent methods ( Yang et al., 2026a ; Wei et al., 2026 ) therefore condition Video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) on projected MLLM hidden states.
paragraphs.zh: 标准条件机制对这些需求的支持有限。 文本编码器（Raffel et al., 2020；Radford et al., 2021）在视觉和时间上的锚定能力有限，而经 VAE 编码的参考内容（Kingma and Welling, 2013）虽然能保留外观，却无法显式表达动作或镜头意图。 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）（Yang et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2024）提供了一种有前景的替代方案（Wang et al., 2026）：其视觉先验和语义推理能力可以帮助解读剧本与参考内容、推断合理的时间细节，并协调各种电影化因素。 因此，近期的方法（Yang et al., 2026a；Wei et al., 2026）以投影后的 MLLM 隐状态作为条件来驱动视频扩散 Transformer（DiT）（Peebles and Xie, 2023）。

paragraphs.en: However, making MLLM features available is different from making them effective for generation. Two obstacles remain: First, MLLM feature bypass is a shared bottleneck for both capabilities: native text-encoder and VAE-reference pathways can reduce the generation loss without substantial reliance on MLLM latents (Fig. 2 ). Second, task-structured supervision is insufficient . For factor-aware control, ordinary video-level training does not explicitly associate an intervention on a particular MLLM span with the intended output change and non-target preservation. For temporal inference, adapting the connector and DiT around a frozen MLLM does not train the MLLM itself to produce temporally informative representations from sparse inputs. Thus, the generator must learn how to use MLLM representations, while the MLLM must also learn what representations to produce for generation.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，使 MLLM 特征可用与使其对生成有效是两回事。 仍存在两个障碍：第一，MLLM 特征旁路是这两种能力共同面临的瓶颈：原生文本编码器通路和 VAE 参考通路可以在不实质依赖 MLLM 潜变量（latents）的情况下降低生成损失（图 2）。 第二，任务结构化的监督是不充分的。 对于因子感知的控制而言，普通的视频级训练并没有显式地将对某个特定 MLLM 片段（span）的干预与预期的输出变化以及非目标内容的保持关联起来。 对于时序推理而言，围绕冻结的 MLLM 去适配连接器与 DiT，并不能训练 MLLM 本身从稀疏输入中产生具有时序信息的表示。 因此，生成器必须学习如何使用 MLLM 表示，而 MLLM 也必须学习应为生成产生什么样的表示。

paragraphs.en: We propose Factor-Aware Predictive Learning (FAPL) to strengthen the use of MLLM representations for temporal inference and factor-aware control through three training stages. First, to strengthen the DiT’s use of MLLM features , Stage I freezes the MLLM and connector and trains the DiT with their projected latents as the sole content conditions, using both text-only and text-plus-complete-video observations. This establishes a generation interface that subsequent stages can use for factor-aware control and predictive learning. Second, to enable factor-aware control , Stage II uses paired videos that change selective cinematic factors while preserving the others. Structured descriptions locate the projected latent spans corresponding to character, scene, action, and camera. Keeping the MLLM and connector frozen, we replace the selected factor span between paired examples and train the DiT against the corresponding video target. The paired videos specify what should change and remain, while span replacement explicitly associates this visual relationship with a localized conditioning intervention, without assuming fully disentangled representations. Finally, to learn temporal inference from sparse inputs , Stage III freezes the trained DiT and jointly optimizes the MLLM and connector using text-only and text-plus-complete-video observations that share a video target. The text-only mode trains prediction from limited evidence, while the complete-video mode provides complementary reconstruction supervision through the same generation interface. The fixed DiT directs learning toward generation-compatible representations without simultaneous decoder adaptation. Experiments evaluate FAPL on sparse-to-video generation, factor-aware editing, and multi-shot generation, with stage-wise ablations examining the respective contributions of strengthened MLLM feature use, factor interventions, and mixed-observation predictive learning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出因子感知预测学习（FAPL），通过三个训练阶段来强化多模态大语言模型（MLLM）表征在时序推理和因子感知控制中的使用。 首先，为强化 DiT 对 MLLM 特征的使用，阶段一冻结 MLLM 和连接器，并以它们投影后的潜变量作为唯一的内容条件来训练 DiT，同时使用纯文本和文本加完整视频两种观测。 这建立了一个生成接口，供后续阶段用于因子感知控制和预测学习。 其次，为实现因子感知控制，阶段二使用成对视频，这些视频在保持其他因素不变的情况下改变选定的电影因素。 结构化描述用于定位与角色、场景、动作和摄像机相对应的投影潜变量片段。 在保持 MLLM 和连接器冻结的情况下，我们在成对样本之间替换被选中的因子片段，并以对应的视频目标来训练 DiT。 成对视频明确规定了什么应当改变、什么应当保持，而片段替换则将这种视觉关系与局部化的条件干预显式关联起来，且不假设表征是完全解耦的。 最后，为从稀疏输入中学习时序推理，阶段三冻结已训练的 DiT，并使用共享同一视频目标的纯文本和文本加完整视频观测来联合优化 MLLM 和连接器。 纯文本模式训练基于有限证据的预测，而完整视频模式则通过同一生成接口提供互补的重构监督。 固定的 DiT 将学习引导至与生成兼容的表征，而无需同时适配解码器。 实验在稀疏到视频生成、因子感知编辑和多镜头生成任务上评估 FAPL，并通过分阶段消融实验考察强化 MLLM 特征使用、因子干预和混合观测预测学习各自的贡献。

sents.zh: 纯文本模式训练基于有限证据的预测，而完整视频模式则通过同一生成接口提供互补的重构监督。

sents.en: The fixed DiT directs learning toward generation-compatible representations without simultaneous decoder adaptation.

sents.en: Experiments evaluate FAPL on sparse-to-video generation, factor-aware editing, and multi-shot generation, with stage-wise ablations examining the respective contributions of strengthened MLLM feature use, factor interventions, and mixed-observation predictive learning.
sents.zh: 实验在稀疏到视频生成、因子感知编辑和多镜头生成任务上评估 FAPL，并通过分阶段消融实验考察强化 MLLM 特征使用、因子干预和混合观测预测学习各自的贡献。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are threefold: (i) We investigate the gap between multimodal understanding and its effective use in cinematic generation, and propose FAPL to translate MLLM understanding into actionable guidance for inference from limited inputs and factor-aware control. (ii) We introduce factor-aware supervision through latent interventions, turning paired edits into structured learning signals for how the generator should change and preserve cinematic content, without assuming fully disentangled representations. (iii) We formulate predictive learning through a fixed generator, linking limited-input prediction and complete-observation reconstruction via shared video targets to learn temporally informative, generation-compatible MLLM representations.

paragraphs.en: Cinematic video generation ( Yang et al., 2026e ; Elmoghany et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026d ) has recently received growing attention for producing shots with specified content, performances, and camera motions from limited materials ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Meng et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026c ) . Existing studies target the two requirements: (i) Inferring content from limited inputs. Reference-driven and multi-shot methods maintain identity and scene consistency from given references ( Xiao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2025 ) . (ii) Factor-Aware Control. Camera motion, character replacement, action transfer, and scene modification are typically handled separately ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Tan et al., 2026a ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026b ; Girish et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 电影级视频生成（Yang et al., 2026e; Elmoghany et al., 2025; Yang et al., 2026d）近来受到越来越多的关注，用于从有限的素材中生成具有指定内容、表演和镜头运动的镜头（Wang et al., 2025a; Meng et al., 2026; Yang et al., 2026c）。 现有研究针对以下两方面需求：（i）从有限输入中推断内容。 基于参考的多镜头方法依据给定参考保持身份与场景的一致性（Xiao et al., 2026; Zhang et al., 2026a; Liu et al., 2025）。 （ii）因子感知的控制。 镜头运动、角色替换、动作迁移和场景修改通常被分别处理（Wang et al., 2023; Tan et al., 2026a; Ye et al., 2026; Jiang et al., 2025; Huang et al., 2026b; Girish et al., 2026; Fang et al., 2026; Huang et al., 2026a）。

paragraphs.en: Recent video diffusion models achieve high-quality synthesis and support a growing range of editing tasks ( Blattmann et al., 2023 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) . To move beyond single-task systems, recent work couples MLLMs with diffusion backbones, either through in-context conditioning ( Ye et al., 2026 ; Ju et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) or through an MLLM understanding branch connected to a generation branch ( Wei et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026a ; Tan et al., 2026b ) . Related studies improve controllability over specific factors such as camera motion ( Wang et al., 2023 ) and subject identity ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . These systems differ in architecture and task coverage, but commonly inject MLLM features alongside text-encoder and VAE reference features through a shared conditioning interface, and supervise training at the video level. Such supervision does not determine how much each condition contributes, and the generator may rely on familiar text and dense visual-reference pathways. Paired editing examples are also typically consumed as additional supervised samples, without explicitly indicating which factor should change and which content should be preserved. In contrast, FAPL strengthens the role of MLLM latents through latent-only training, and uses factor-span replacement between paired examples to supervise factor-aware changes and preservation.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的视频扩散模型实现了高质量合成，并支持日益丰富的编辑任务（Blattmann et al., 2023；Kong et al., 2024；Wan et al., 2025）。 为了超越单任务系统，近期工作将多模态大语言模型与扩散骨干网络相结合，或通过上下文条件化（Ye et al., 2026；Ju et al., 2025；Jiang et al., 2025），或通过连接到生成分支的多模态大语言模型理解分支（Wei et al., 2026；Yang et al., 2026a；Tan et al., 2026b）。 相关研究还提升了对特定因素的可控性，例如相机运动（Wang et al., 2023）和主体身份（Liu et al., 2025）。 这些系统在架构和任务覆盖面上各不相同，但通常通过共享的条件接口将多模态大语言模型特征与文本编码器和VAE参考特征一同注入，并在视频层面进行训练监督。 这种监督方式无法确定每个条件各自的贡献大小，生成器可能依赖于熟悉的文本通路和稠密的视觉参考通路。 成对的编辑样本通常也只是作为额外的监督样本被使用，而没有明确指出哪些因素应当改变、哪些内容应当保留。 与之相反，FAPL通过仅潜变量训练强化了多模态大语言模型潜变量的作用，并利用成对样本之间的因素跨度替换来监督面向因素的改变与保留。

paragraphs.en: Joint-embedding predictive architectures learn representations by predicting target features from partial observations rather than reconstructing pixels, avoiding unpredictable low-level details ( Assran et al., 2023 ) , and extend to action-conditioned future prediction for planning and control ( Bardes et al., 2024 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) . Generative models also decode predicted representations into visual outputs. However, such models usually learn task-specific spaces without high-fidelity video decoders, or require separately trained decoders, and rarely use paired editing data to supervise factor-level change and preservation. In contrast, we reuse a pretrained MLLM and Video DiT and supervise prediction through visual reconstruction with a fixed generator, preserving the decoding pathway while training the MLLM to infer video content from limited observations.
paragraphs.zh: 联合嵌入预测架构通过从部分观测中预测目标特征来学习表征，而非重构像素，从而避免了不可预测的低层细节（Assran et al., 2023），并可扩展到以动作为条件的未来预测，用于规划与控制（Bardes et al., 2024; Assran et al., 2025）。 生成式模型也会将预测的表征解码为视觉输出。 然而，这类模型通常学习的是任务特定的空间而缺乏高保真视频解码器，或需要单独训练解码器，且很少利用成对的编辑数据来监督因子层面的变化与保持。 相比之下，我们复用预训练的 MLLM 和 Video DiT，并通过固定生成器的视觉重构来监督预测，在保留解码路径的同时训练 MLLM 从有限的观测中推断视频内容。

paragraphs.en: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning (FAPL) trains MLLM representations for limited-input temporal inference and factor-aware control of character, scene, action, and camera. It structures supervision in generation space: factor-span interventions use paired edits to link localized latent changes to target-factor changes and non-target preservation, while shared-target predictive learning couples limited-input prediction with complete-observation reconstruction through a fixed generator. MLLM-only conditioning strengthens the DiT’s use of these representations, supporting both mechanisms without architectural changes.
paragraphs.zh: 因子感知预测学习（FAPL）对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的表征进行训练，用于有限输入的时间推理，以及对角色、场景、动作和镜头的因子感知控制。 它在生成空间中构建监督：因子跨度干预使用成对编辑，将局部化的潜在变化与目标因子的变化及非目标因子的保持联系起来；同时共享目标预测学习通过一个固定的生成器，将有限输入预测与完整观测重建耦合起来。 仅使用 MLLM 的条件控制强化了扩散 Transformer（DiT）对这些表征的利用，在不做架构改动的情况下支持上述两种机制。

paragraphs.en: We first describe the framework and paired data in Sec. 3.1 . Training then proceeds in three stages: (i) MLLM-Only Generator Grounding strengthens the DiT’s use of MLLM features (Sec. 3.2 ); (ii) Factor-Aware Control Improvement trains the DiT to realize target-factor changes while preserving other content through factor-span replacement (Sec. 3.3 ); and (iii) Prediction From Limited Inputs optimizes the MLLM and connector through the fixed DiT using shared targets across observation modes (Sec. 3.4 ). paragraphs.en: MLLM-conditioned video diffusion ( Yang et al., 2026a ; Wei et al., 2026 ) connects an MLLM to a pretrained Video DiT. The DiT is trained through flow matching ( Lipman et al., 2022 ) and receives three concatenated conditions: C = [ C text ; C mllm ; C ref ] C=[C^{\mathrm{text}};C^{\mathrm{mllm}};C^{\mathrm{ref}}] , comprising text-encoder features, MLLM features, and VAE-encoded visual features, respectively. Here, [ ⋅ ; ⋅ ] [\cdot;\cdot] denotes concatenation along the token dimension. Individual backbones may omit a pathway. For example, UniVideo ( Wei et al., 2026 ) removes the original text encoders.

paragraphs.en: At inference, FAPL supports three cinematic applications within one architecture. (i) Generation from Scripts and References. Given a script and optional character or scene references, the MLLM produces latents that condition the DiT through the trained connector and original interface, followed by flow-based sampling and VAE decoding. No complete target video is needed. The DiT can use MLLM latents alone or together with the original text and VAE reference conditions as separate inference configurations. (ii) Factor-Aware Control. We modify only the target factor’s field in the structured prompt and re-encode the edited prompt through the MLLM and connector. We then replace the corresponding span in the original projected latents with the edited field’s span, keeping all other spans unchanged, and condition the DiT on the resulting sequence. We evaluate both the requested change and non-target preservation. (iii) Multi-Shot Generation. Shots are generated independently from their descriptions and available references. Shared character and scene references promote consistency, while action and camera instructions vary by shot.
paragraphs.zh: 在推理阶段，FAPL 在同一架构内支持三种影视化应用。 (i) 从剧本与参考生成。 给定剧本以及可选的角色或场景参考，多模态大语言模型生成潜在表示，通过训练好的连接器与原始接口对 DiT 进行条件控制，随后进行基于流的采样与 VAE 解码。 无需完整的目标视频。 DiT 可以仅使用多模态大语言模型的潜在表示，或将其与原始文本及 VAE 参考条件共同使用，作为不同的推理配置。 (ii) 因子感知的控制。 我们只修改结构化提示中目标因子的字段，并通过多模态大语言模型与连接器对编辑后的提示重新编码。 然后用编辑后字段的片段替换原始投影潜在表示中的对应片段，保持其余片段不变，并以所得序列对 DiT 进行条件控制。 我们同时评估所请求的改动以及非目标内容的保持。 (iii) 多镜头生成。 各镜头根据其描述和可用参考独立生成。 共享的角色与场景参考促进一致性，而动作与镜头指令则因镜头而异。

paragraphs.en: We build FAPL on UniVideo ( Wei et al., 2026 ) with a 13B DiT and compare with the original UniVideo and Omni-Video 2 ( Yang et al., 2026a ) models (1.3B, 14B DiTs). Stages I and III sample text-only and text-plus-complete-video observations at a 1:1 ratio, while Stage II uses text-only inputs with factor-span replacement. We train Stages I–III for 10K, 15K, and 10K steps, respectively, using AdamW with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , zero weight decay, and a maximum gradient norm of 1.0. Training uses the bfloat16 (BF16) format and gradient checkpointing. Inference uses 50 sampling steps and a classifier-free guidance (CFG) scale of 5.0. All three stages share 100K quality-filtered source–target video pairs (25K per factor), constructed through factor-specific selection and generation using CoinVE-200K ( Long et al., 2026 ) as the primary source and OmniVBench’s released training data ( Li et al., 2026 ) for supplementary videos and references.

sents.en: Each sequence comprises two to four shots in their original order, with shared character and scene references and shot-specific action and camera instructions.
sents.zh: 每个序列由按原始顺序排列的两到四个镜头组成，具有共享的角色和场景参考，以及镜头特定的动作和摄像机指令。

paragraphs.en: (i) Temporal generation from limited inputs. Within shots, we measure action sequencing with Motion Order ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) and camera-trajectory fidelity with Translation Error and Rotation Error (radians) ( Yang et al., 2026c ) , using frozen π 3 \pi^{3} ( Wang et al., 2025c ) for trajectory recovery. To complement these action/camera measures, multi-shot evaluation assesses character and scene consistency as shot-specific instructions vary, using Subject Consistency, Scene Consistency ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , and FaceSim-Arc for facial identity ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) . (ii) Factor-aware control. We evaluate single-factor edits using FiVE’s ∩ \cap -Acc ( Li et al., 2025 ) , requiring both yes/no and multiple-choice checks to pass.
paragraphs.zh: (i) 基于有限输入的时序生成。 在镜头内部，我们使用 Motion Order（Zheng et al., 2025）衡量动作序列，使用 Translation Error 和 Rotation Error（弧度）（Yang et al., 2026c）衡量相机轨迹保真度，并采用冻结的 π 3 \pi^{3}（Wang et al., 2025c）进行轨迹恢复。 为了补充这些动作/相机指标，多镜头评估在镜头特定指令变化时评估角色与场景的一致性，使用 Subject Consistency、Scene Consistency（Wang et al., 2025b）以及用于面部身份的 FaceSim-Arc（Yuan et al., 2025）。 (ii) 因素感知的可控性。 我们使用 FiVE 的 ∩ \cap -Acc（Li et al., 2025）评估单因素编辑，要求是非判断题和选择题检查同时通过。

paragraphs.en: Tab. 1 compares FAPL with Omni-Video 2 and UniVideo on sparse-to-video generation, factor-aware editing, and multi-shot generation. FAPL improves action ordering and camera-trajectory fidelity from text alone, achieves higher ∩ \cap -Acc for requested factor changes, and obtains stronger Subject and Scene Consistency across shots, indicating that shot-specific instructions remain compatible with shared character and scene content. For multi-shot generation, FAPL achieves a FaceSim-Arc score of 0.523, compared with 0.412 for Omni-Video 2 (1.3B), 0.468 for Omni-Video 2 (14B), and 0.451 for UniVideo (13B). This improvement complements the Subject and Scene Consistency results, indicating stronger facial identity consistency as action and camera instructions vary across shots. In the examples shown in Figs. 4 , 5 , and 7 , UniVideo captures the broad content but misses specified details such as hair length, hand gestures, or the requested orbit, and some edits also alter non-target factors. FAPL follows these specifications more closely while preserving unrelated factors, and maintains the shared setting and character appearance across shots. These comparisons suggest that FAPL improves instruction following and cross-shot consistency on the evaluated tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 表1在稀疏到视频生成、因子感知编辑和多镜头生成任务上将FAPL与Omni-Video 2和UniVideo进行了比较。 FAPL仅凭文本即可改进动作顺序和相机轨迹保真度，对请求的因子变化实现更高的∩ \cap -Acc，并在各镜头之间获得更强的主体和场景一致性，表明针对镜头的指令与共享的角色和场景内容保持兼容。 在多镜头生成方面，FAPL取得了0.523的FaceSim-Arc分数，而Omni-Video 2（1.3B）为0.412，Omni-Video 2（14B）为0.468，UniVideo（13B）为0.451。 这一改进补充了主体和场景一致性结果，表明随着动作和相机指令在各镜头间变化，面部身份一致性更强。 在图4、图5和图7所示的示例中，UniVideo能够捕捉大致内容，但会遗漏指定的细节，例如头发长度、手势或所请求的环绕运动，且部分编辑还会改变非目标因子。 FAPL能更严格地遵循这些规格要求，同时保持无关因子不变，并在各镜头之间维持共享的场景设定和角色外观。 这些比较表明，FAPL在所评估的任务上提升了指令遵循能力和跨镜头一致性。

paragraphs.en: Tab. 2 evaluates the three training stages on UniVideo (13B). Stage I improves action ordering and reduces both camera errors relative to the pretrained model. Fig. 7 further illustrates improved generation under MLLM-only conditioning after Stage I on Omni-Video 2 (1.3B and 14B) and UniVideo (13B). For Stage II, training with factor swapping achieves 57% ∩ \cap -Acc, compared with 48% for training without factor swapping under the same paired data and optimization budget. Motion Order and camera errors do not improve over this control, suggesting that the benefit is concentrated in factor-aware editing. For Stage III, mixed-observation training improves Motion Order from 57% to 61% and reduces translation and rotation errors from 0.0629 to 0.0586 and from 1.26 to 1.02 radians, respectively, compared with text-only training. Editing accuracy remains comparable to the Stage II checkpoint, changing from 57% to 58%. These results suggest that complete-video observations during training help action ordering and camera control under prompt-only inference while retaining factor-aware editing performance.
paragraphs.zh: 表 2 在 UniVideo（13B）上评估了三个训练阶段。 阶段 I 改进了动作顺序，并相对预训练模型降低了两种相机误差。 图 7 进一步展示了在 Omni-Video 2（1.3B 和 14B）以及 UniVideo（13B）上，阶段 I 之后仅使用 MLLM 条件时生成质量的提升。 对于阶段 II，在相同的成对数据和优化预算下，采用因子交换训练可达到 57% ∩ \cap -Acc，而不采用因子交换训练则为 48%。 相对于该对照设置，Motion Order 和相机误差并未提升，表明其收益集中在因子感知编辑上。 对于阶段 III，与仅使用文本训练相比，混合观测训练将 Motion Order 从 57% 提升至 61%，并将平移误差和旋转误差分别从 0.0629 降至 0.0586、从 1.26 弧度降至 1.02 弧度。 编辑准确率与阶段 II 的检查点相当，从 57% 变为 58%。 这些结果表明，训练期间的完整视频观测有助于在仅提示词推理下改进动作顺序和相机控制，同时保留因子感知编辑的性能。

paragraphs.en: This work studies how MLLM representations can support temporal inference and factor-aware control in cinematic video generation. FAPL makes these representations actionable by grounding the DiT in MLLM latents, supervising factor-specific changes and preservation, and learning prediction from limited inputs. FAPL demonstrates that targeting the right bottleneck delivers substantial gains without added architectural complexity. Our findings further offer insights into how multimodal reasoning and generation can reinforce each other: reasoning guides controllable synthesis, while generation provides grounded supervision for learning to infer missing content from limited observations.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作研究 MLLM 表征如何在电影级视频生成中支持时间推理与基于因素的控制。 FAPL 通过将 DiT 锚定于 MLLM 的潜在表征、对因素相关的变化与保持进行监督，并从有限输入中学习预测，使这些表征变得可操作。 FAPL 证明，针对正确的瓶颈进行优化可以在不增加架构复杂性的情况下带来显著收益。 我们的发现进一步揭示了多模态推理与生成如何相互增强：推理引导可控合成，而生成为从有限观测中学习推断缺失内容提供了有依据的监督。

paragraphs.en: Although FAPL addresses a fundamental weakness of existing MLLM-conditioned DiTs by making MLLM latents more actionable, its performance remains bounded by the underlying models. Current MLLMs struggle to interpret 3D blockouts or reason about complex camera motion for DiT control, while the pretrained DiT limits visual fidelity and complex factor realization, such as realistic acting. Future work may incorporate stronger MLLMs and more capable video generators.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 FAPL 通过使 MLLM 潜变量更易于执行，解决了现有以 MLLM 为条件的 DiT 的一个根本性缺陷，但其性能仍受限于底层模型。 当前的 MLLM 难以解读 3D 块状遮挡体，也难以针对 DiT 控制推理复杂的相机运动，而预训练的 DiT 则限制了视觉保真度和复杂因素的实现，例如逼真的表演。 未来的工作可以引入更强的 MLLM 和更强大的视频生成器。
